subject.title: Tool outputs sometimes render as image attachments and become unreadable to the agent

question: Should maintainers treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100795 as the canonical broad fix for this issue, or land the narrower https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99756 first?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same user-visible failure from different scopes, and choosing the canonical landing path is a maintainer review decision rather than a new ClawSweeper repair job.

options.title: Use the broad fix as canonical
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100795 once its draft/review state is resolved, then close this issue and decide whether narrower PRs should be superseded.

options.title: Land the narrow fix first
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99756 as the immediate repair, then keep this issue or a follow-up open for payload-less media and provider-sibling hardening.

options.title: Keep both open for more proof
options.body: Request a captured model-submitted payload from an affected session before choosing either PR as canonical.

recommendation.title: Use the broad fix as canonical
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100795 once its draft/review state is resolved, then close this issue and decide whether narrower PRs should be superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: amknight owns the broad active PR that centralizes the remaining media-payload and fresh-result sanitization path.
